notes: Schedule 1 (Form 1040) line 8b for the bounded 2025 class: gambling winnings not attributable to a trade or business, equal to the closed Form W-2G box 1 family subtotal (i1040gi-2025 l.6561-6575). Winnings without a Form W-2G, gambling that is a business, and gambling losses are outside the class and stay refused by answer (see rule.w2g-b1-subtotal and the w2g-scope answer on line 10). Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 1): the subtotal it reads now carries cents, so this line rounds it once with the rounding convention. A whole-dollar subtotal gives the same value as before.
